dtm.source: HiRISE DTM from stereo pair PSP_006133_1410 / PSP_007056_1410, 1 m posts, NASA/JPL/University of Arizona (PDS)
dtm.rationale: Complex banded flow terrain on floor of Hellas Basin (HiRISE team)
dtm.method: mean of 1 m posts per 30 m cell; cells with under half coverage are no-data

fine_slope.method: DTM averaged to 3 m, slope from central differences, 3 x 3 median, maximum within the 30 m cell

fill.use: 3D display, horizon and line of sight: DTM, else MOLA 128 px/deg shifted by -0.7 m
